column1: # Partition table — 4MB flash with dual OTA + SPIFFS (SECURE variant)
# Sibling to ota_4mb_wifi.csv. Used only by [env:secure] (secure boot v2 +
# Layout follows ota_4mb_wifi.csv (post-#1117) so a fielded dash running an
# unsigned _wifi image and a future dash running this signed image share the
# same on-flash partition geometry. That makes the migration to secure boot
# a one-shot USB reflash on the production-flash workstation without first
# rebuilding the partition table (the live bootloader still sees the same
# offsets). It also keeps a single SPIFFS offset (0x370000) across every
# build target — the scripts that flash SPIFFS images (Studio
#   - nvs shrunk 20 KB → 16 KB to make room for the 4 KB nvs_keys partition
#   - nvs_keys (4 KB) added at 0xd000 — holds the encrypted-NVS key
#     (encrypted under the chip's flash encryption key)
#     Espressif's ROM reads them in the clear)
